## Overview
Create a data quality checker that validates GoT data meets requirements for causal analysis.

## File References
- Implementation: cortical/got/causal_analysis.py (add CausalDataQuality class)
- Data gaps reference: CLAUDE.md (section: Current Data Gaps)
- GoT store: cortical/got/versioned_store.py

## Quality Metrics to Check
| Metric | Target | Calculation |
|--------|--------|-------------|
| started_at coverage | 90%+ | tasks with started_at / total tasks |
| completed_at coverage | 90%+ | completed tasks with timestamp / completed |
| retrospective coverage | 80%+ | tasks with retrospective / completed |
| blocked_reason coverage | 100% | blocked with reason / blocked |
| edge density | 1.5+ | total edges / total tasks |
| causal edge ratio | 30%+ | (DEPENDS_ON + CAUSED_BY + BLOCKS) / total edges |

## Output Format
```
CAUSAL DATA QUALITY REPORT
==========================
Overall Score: 78/100 (GOLD TIER)

✅ Task volume: 263 tasks (excellent)
✅ Priority coverage: 100%
⚠️ started_at coverage: 24% (target: 90%)
❌ retrospective coverage: 27% (target: 80%)
...

Recommendations:
1. Run 'task start' before beginning work
2. Add retrospectives when completing tasks
```

## Acceptance Criteria
- Produces actionable report
- Tiered scoring (Bronze/Silver/Gold/Platinum)
- Specific recommendations for improvement
